signalOfTheWeek.headline: Quillmere: job posts mention SOC 2 and security questionnaires
signalOfTheWeek.body: Job posts mention SOC 2 and security questionnaires. Companies at this stage usually start a compliance program within a quarter. This is sample data, shown until the engine produces a real week.
